subject: Mutual evidence & acceptance plan — next steps

Subject: Mutual evidence & acceptance plan — draft for review

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, I pulled together a compact plan that maps acceptance tests to the MAP milestones and the artifacts ClearPath will provide to prove acceptance. The goal is to keep the evaluation short (6 weeks), make pass/fail criteria objective, and lock in the cutover conditions for the pilot.

Key asks in the attached workbook:
- Review the Acceptance Tests tab and mark any items you consider blockers.
- Confirm the sampling cadence (we proposed 50 daily calls, minimum 5 business days)
- Flag any compliance docs you need from us (audit logs, data retention config).

I've attached: MAP-draft-20260529.xlsx (MAP timeline + owners), acceptance-tests-v1.md (test definitions), evidence-checklist-template.csv (artifact checklist).

Proposed next steps: you and your team mark changes in the sheet by EOD Tuesday 6/1 and we'll lock the MAP and create the HubSpot deal record for procurement.

If it's helpful, Marcus can run a short session with your SRE team on the telemetry we'll collect.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-draft-20260529.xlsx (workbook), acceptance-tests-v1.md (text), evidence-checklist-template.csv (csv)
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: ClearPath Health Procurement <procurement@clearpathhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual evidence & acceptance plan — draft for review

Diego —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clarity. Quick read-through and initial comments below (I inline a few items). I'll share with our SRE and Data Governance folks this afternoon.

Inline: 
> Review the Acceptance Tests tab and mark any items you consider blockers.
- On Test #3 (PHI redaction spot-checks) we need 100% redaction for the sample set; if the failure rate > 0.5% we need a remediation window and retest requirement.

> Confirm the sampling cadence (we proposed 50 daily calls, minimum 5 business days)
- We can do 75 daily calls for the first week, then drop to 50/day. That front-load helps us catch early regressions.

> Flag any compliance docs you need from us
- We'll need the SOC 2 evidence that shows log retention policies and a statement on key access controls.

Two procurement notes: 1) We need the MAP to explicitly state what constitutes an "acceptance event" vs. a "pilot milestone" and 2) procurement wants a lightweight cancel/rollback clause tied to the acceptance tests timeline. I've CC'd procurement for visibility.

Samantha Lee
Director, Product Operations | ClearPath Health

Samantha —

Thanks for the quick notes and the front-loaded sampling suggestion — that makes sense and improves signal. Two clarifications from our side on acceptance mechanics:

1) Acceptance event = successful completion of the Acceptance Tests set (pass thresholds met) and artifacts uploaded to the evidence drive.
2) Pilot milestone = interim checkpoints (Week 1 smoke, Week 3 mid-eval, Week 6 close).

On rollback language: we can agree to a 10-business-day remediation window following a failing acceptance event. If remediation fails, either party may pause the pilot and revert to the prior model variant; the procurement/legal teams can formalize in the contract. Lauren, can you weigh in on standard procurement-friendly phrasing?

Also adding our telemetry owner offer — Marcus can run the instrumentation call with your SRE.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Product Lead, Developer Experience | Redwood Inference

All —

Great progress today — summarizing the commitments so we have a single source of truth: 

1) Timeline: 6-week evaluation window starting 2026-06-07 (Week 0 onboarding, Week 1 smoke/front-load sampling, Week 3 mid-eval, Week 6 acceptance decision).
2) Acceptance tests: use acceptance-tests-v1.md as canonical; Test #3 PHI redaction threshold set to <= 0.5% failure, with a 10-business-day remediation window on failure.
3) Evidence: ClearPath will upload evidence bundles to the shared Drive folder (link above). Redwood will provide an example bundle by Monday 6/7. Log retention confirmed for 90 days — engineering will surface the retention config document.
4) Rollback/stop clause: procurement to propose contract language; temporary pause allowed if remediation fails.
5) Instrumentation: Marcus to run a 45-min telemetry sync with ClearPath SRE on Monday 6/7 (Grace to send calendar invite).

Attachments included again: acceptance-tests-v1.md, evidence-checklist-template.csv. I'll also open the HubSpot deal and attach the MAP workbook so procurement has visibility.

If anyone needs this as a short one-pager for their legal team I can produce it today.

Thanks —
Diego
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
